name: Mather Process Solutions
old_description: We specialize in further processing equipment. We have a large variety of used equipment that can be purchased in as is condition, most of these items are also available as fully remanufactured items that come with a warranty.
about:
Mather Process Solutions operates from Bellevue, Ohio, where it was founded in 1951. The company runs its Process Equipment Warehouse division from this location, though details about its ownership structure or founding individuals are not publicly disclosed.

The business focuses on further processing equipment for the food industry, offering both used machinery sold as-is and fully remanufactured units backed by a warranty. Its capabilities span sales, design, service, and remanufacturing of equipment such as breaders, batter applicators, fryers, ovens, conveyors, and oil filtration systems. The company emphasizes on-site testing and a 100% performance guarantee on remanufactured items.

Mather Process Solutions serves food manufacturers and further-processing operations, working with leading OEM brands including Stein, JBT, and MP Equipment. The company actively seeks specific models like the Stein DB-4 Drum Breeder and MP Equipment 120 Drum Breeder for its inventory, and recently featured a Stein JBT HPF 3423 gas-fired fryer as equipment of the month.

The company highlights its 75-plus years of experience in the sector and its commitment to on-site testing with a full performance guarantee as key differentiators. It also provides a warranty on remanufactured equipment, aiming to reduce risk for buyers of used processing machinery.
